children: Tectonic Therapeutic announced favorable Phase 1a safety, tolerability and PK results for TX2100 and FDA Fast Track plus IND clearance.
FDA granted Fast Track designation for TX2100 in HHT and cleared the IND for the Phase 1b trial in the U.S.
Phase 1a topline: single ascending doses were generally safe and well-tolerated in 48 healthy volunteers across six cohorts.
No deaths, serious adverse events or severe TEAEs; TEAEs were mild/moderate and transient; ADA results pending.
PK showed target-mediated drug disposition consistent with high-affinity APJ receptor binding and strong target engagement.
Plans to start open-label Phase 1b by year-end 2026 and a placebo-controlled Phase 2 in early 2027; dose selection informed by PK and nonclinical models.
